    direction TB

    class ChunkedStream {
        ~int DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE$
        -PushbackInputStream in
        -int chunkSize
        -long offset
        -boolean closed
        +ChunkedStream(InputStream in)
        +ChunkedStream(InputStream in, int chunkSize)
        +transferredBytes() long
        +isEndOfInput() boolean
        +close() void
        +readChunk(ChannelHandlerContext ctx) ByteBuf
        +readChunk(ByteBufAllocator allocator) ByteBuf
        +length() long
        +progress() long
    }

    class ChunkedInput~B~ {
        <<interface>>
        +isEndOfInput() boolean
        +close() void
        +readChunk(ChannelHandlerContext ctx) B
        +readChunk(ByteBufAllocator allocator) B
        +length() long
        +progress() long
    }

    class ByteBuf {
        <<abstract>>
        +writeBytes(InputStream in, int length) int
        +release() boolean
    }
    class ByteBufAllocator {
        <<interface>>
        +buffer(int initialCapacity) ByteBuf
    }
    class ChannelHandlerContext {
        <<interface>>
        +alloc() ByteBufAllocator
    }
    class ObjectUtil {
        <<final>>
        +checkNotNull(T arg, String text)$ T
        +checkPositive(int i, String name)$ int
    }
    class InputStream {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class PushbackInputStream {
        +available() int
        +read() int
        +unread(int b) void
        +close() void
    }

    class ChunkedNioStream
    class ChunkedNioFile
    class ChunkedFile

    ChunkedInput <|.. ChunkedStream : implements ChunkedInput~ByteBuf~
    ChunkedInput <|.. ChunkedNioStream
    ChunkedInput <|.. ChunkedNioFile
    ChunkedInput <|.. ChunkedFile

    ChunkedStream *-- PushbackInputStream : -in
    InputStream <|-- PushbackInputStream

    ChunkedFile ..> ChunkedStream : uses DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE
